instructions: Create the final approved-target-driven trim challenger using a custom low-frequency, low-contrast wood grain and a more restrained cross-section. The v001 and v002 evaluations show that the original generated texture becomes repeated warm bands and the solid material is too uniform; use a distinct anisotropic grain material with no normal map, and reduce each profile to a broad face and a few shallow transitions. Preserve the 48 x 5 x 1.4-inch sample envelope and all RoomDefinition-owned geometry and gameplay data.
tool: Godot GDScript + shared profile mesh builder
material_method: Custom anisotropic low-frequency grayscale wood grain with matte stained-wood response and no generated normal map

import_configuration.runtime_geometry: shared profile helper; RoomDefinition dimensions remain authoritative
